## Summary

Describe the change and its purpose.

## Change type

- [ ] Workbook or formula update
- [ ] Policy or source update
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] GitHub Actions or maintenance update
- [ ] Release asset update

## Validation

- [ ] The workbook opens without repair warnings.
- [ ] Existing formulas, named ranges, tables, and dashboard links remain intact.
- [ ] Tax or salary rule changes include an authoritative source reference.
- [ ] Relevant test cases were reviewed or updated.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or unrelated binary files are included.
- [ ] GitHub Actions use immutable commit SHAs.

## Evidence

List the source documents, test cases, screenshots, or calculations used to validate this change.
